profile_text.body:
Rev is a for-profit company founded in 2010 and headquartered in Austin, TX. The company describes itself as an investigative intelligence and legal transcription platform built for investigations that hold up in court. Its site presents a legal AI platform that turns digital evidence into verified, citable findings, and it offers tools including multi-file evidence analysis, an AI image analyzer that reviews photos and cites the exact image behind each answer, AI templates for tasks such as incident timelines, evidentiary discrepancies, statement of facts, and oral argument prep, as well as a transcript editor, document editor, and mobile app. The company states it is trusted by bar associations and legal organizations across the country and describes itself as the State Bar of Texas's first official legal AI partner.

Rev's core tracked product is Rev AI, a voice and audio offering that encompasses a speech-to-text API, transcription, captioning, and a human-plus-AI hybrid service with data confidentiality. The site also provides a cost estimator for human and AI transcripts, captions, and subtitles, and allows users to build custom AI templates in addition to choosing from a ready-made library. The held facts show the company has notable legal exposure in Texas, with 82 associated cases recorded there, which is consistent with its stated partnership with the State Bar of Texas and its focus on the legal market.
